notes.title: Update 1.11 Windowed Mode + Resizable Window
notes.content:
Hey, hey! Day one patch is here! 

Here are the notes:

- The resolution of the game should now scale much better with all monitors
- Switch between windowed and full-screen with Alt+Enter
- Resize the windowed mode to fit your heart's desire!

notes.title: Important Update: Release Date and Exciting News!
notes.content:
Hi there,

It's Lew here, the developer of Cards of Divinity!

I hope you're all doing well! I wanted to take a moment to share some news about the release date. After careful consideration, I've decided to delay the launch of Cards of Divinity slightly to early January, because I truly believe that delivering the best possible version of the game is worth the extra time. This will give me a chance to fine-tune the balance, squash some remaining bugs, and make sure everything feels just right when you dive in.

In the meantime, I hope you've noticed the updated "About" section on the game's Steam page and there's more exciting news on the way: keep an eye out for the official trailer, which will be coming very soon.

As always, thank you so much for your patience and support, I’m working hard to make sure Cards of Divinity is the best it could be when it comes out!

Feel free to drop by our Discord @ https://discord.gg/vDtVvJWzxj if you’d like to chat, share feedback, or just hang out.

Cheers,
Lew

notes.title: CARDIFICATION UPDATE!
notes.content:
Hey, hey, everyone!

I am extremely happy to present the CARDIFICATION Update to you! 

What you'll find has changed:

-All choice menus were converted into playable cards.

-Access to a 'Heroic Souls' hand whenever you use a hero token.

-Constant access to an 'Enhancement Hand' containing enhancements you can play on your heroes.

-Enhancements now have a mana cost.

-Spell Strangers, some of the strangers allow you to trigger one-time effects like removing cards from your enhancement deck or gaining new hero tokens.

-New realm enemies and a plethora of reworked and improved enemy enhancements!

-Much, much more, including tweaks and bug fixes!

I am looking forward to hearing your feedback on our official Discord at https://discord.gg/vDtVvJWzxj 
See you there!

notes.title: The Divine Rework Is Here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743058/68f93ce1a92e9c32a53907e3322a54a9d53ad1f8.png[/img]Greetings! 

Hi there,

I'm exceptionally thrilled to announce that the rework is finally here!

There are so many changes, tweaks, and small balance updates that it would take a week to list them all, so I will try to keep myself to mentioning only the truly major changes and the rest is for you to check out in-game in the demo!

- Card Battler Edition: The game is now a pure Card Battler, you can re-arrange the heroes on the board by dragging them and choose which enemy you want to attack by placing your hero in front of them.

- Hero Deck: Before starting your playthrough you will be able to pick the heroes you will have access to throughout your run.

- Enhancement Deck: Each hero in your hero deck will contribute a unique enhancement to your enhancement deck, essentially allowing your summoned heroes to learn enhancements that come from those on your bench.

- Personal Heroic Enhancement Decks: When hovering over a hero in-play, a personal enhancement deck to that hero will become visible beside them allowing you to cycle through all the enhancements of that hero.

- Enhancement Stacking: You can now stack enhancements on each of your heroes by picking the same enhancement multiple times, which will increase it's power.

- Strangers Rewards: Strangers no longer offer a choice between immediate stat increase, but instead allow you to choose new and powerful abilities for your enhancement deck, which will then be available to your heroes when enhancing.

- Life Lotus: Every hero has their own Life Lotus now. The Life Lotus represents your heroes remaining lifespan. After every conquered realm, Hades will send his servant to take a petal from each of your heroes. No hero is immune to the passage of time!

- Future Heroes Boosts: New hero actives and enhancements which will allow you to improve the stats of heroes you summon in the future to allow you to face the endless challenges ahead.

- Endless Realm Progression: Realms you conquer will rebel against you after being away for too long, creating an endless loop of realm conquest with ever-evolving challenges and enemies for your heroes to face!

- Divine Leaderboard: Implemented a steam leaderboard to accommodate competition now that the game is truly Endless!

notes.title: The Overhauling Update
notes.content:
[b]The Overhauling Update is here![/b] ❤️‍🔥 💝 💘 
I present to you a new and even slicker Cards of Divinity! Let me quickly go over the changes you will find in the new update!

[b]The Class System[/b]
Three classes: 🛡️Guardian, ⚔️Striker, and 🧙‍♀️Mage. 
Think of these as rock-paper-scissors.
Guardians deal double damage to Strikers.
Strikers deal double damage to Mages.
And Mages deal double damage to Guardians.
This applies to damage done through attacking or defending.

[b]Limited Hero Tokens 💎[/b]
You now begin the game with 5 hero tokens and you no longer get new ones when succeeding Trials.
Persephone's Dagger has been removed.
Essentially, once your 5th hero is killed, your run is over. (You can use heroes like Odysseus to bypass this rule slightly)

[b]The Progression System 🗺️[/b]
You can now choose which trials you will encounter as you progress through the game.
At the start of the game, you will begin with 1 Campfire Token which you can activate to rest before you begin your adventure.
When you activate the Token you will get to choose which of the three strangers you would like to meet at the Campfire - Homer, the Oracle, or the Jester. Each one of them presents you with a different way to improve your party of heroes.
After choosing one of the books presented by the stragers you will receive a Boss Token (which will be renamed to Trial Token) which you can activate to choose the next Trial you will face.
After defeating the chosen Trial, you will receive a new Boss Token, then another Campfire Token, and then the steps will repeat until you reach the final Trial.
Additionally, all your heroes will be restored to their base health after every trial.

[b]Updated Trials 📗[/b]
Trials are now represented by a trial card which you can obtain after defeating all enemies.
(e.g. Trial of Agility, Wisdom, Opulence, etc.)
Every trial has a favored enemy type which it is likely to summon, represented by the icon beneath the trial's portrait.


NEXT: More updates, a new tutorial in-game to reflect all the changes, more heroes, more trials, more enemies, more everything! 

Wishlist and spread the word to help out with the development, it really counts!
